scope: Retrospective near-term predictive validation of previously selected indicators. Reuses historical data; no prospective, final-VP, or policy-strength claim.

design.window: Non-phasing O at start of P player turn, Game Turns 2-8, with a following recorded row. The final player turn is excluded.
design.outcomes: Recorded O objective/step losses during P turn; positive rise in O outOfTrace or decline in HQ count to the following row. stepsLost counts all recorded step-loss events.
design.models: Zero event; training median; training mean; intercept plus distance baseline; intercept plus baseline plus metric; training conditional medians in baseline or metric buckets. Baseline and intercept unpenalized; standardized added metric fixed ridge penalty 1. Buckets fixed at 0, 1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+ from the historical descriptive analysis. Unseen bucket falls back to training median. No hyperparameter search. Complete cases shared across models; train-only preprocessing.
design.primarySplit: Ten folds of map seed, sorted by SHA256 and assigned round-robin. All styles, roles, policy variants and aliases of a seed stay together.
design.sensitivitySplit: Each source parent directory is one held-out batch. Training excludes every trajectory with any alias in that batch and every map seed appearing in its test data. Batches are reported separately because test trajectories can have multiple aliases.
design.batchMeaning: Provenance source parent directory, not independently verified policy version. Policy strings and variants are aliases retained verbatim.
design.intervals: 1000 paired seed-cluster draws on fixed out-of-fold errors. Conditional, exploratory intervals without multiplicity correction.

intervals.scope: Paired map-seed cluster resampling of fixed held-out errors. Conditional on fitted folds; no refitting or model-selection uncertainty.
